_comment: Demo safety net for the live Account Research agent. If the live call fails or times out, load the matching entry into Account.accountResearch / accountAiContext and set researchedAt. Firmographic stack specifics are inferred ICP-fit assumptions, not asserted private facts.

ACC005.name: Vuori
ACC005.accountResearch: Hyper-growth DTC athletic/lifestyle apparel brand (Carlsbad, CA; founded 2015) selling through its own ecommerce store and a fast-expanding retail footprint, backed by large growth rounds. Brand- and retention-led with a heavy lifecycle motion and rich first-party customer + order data. Inferred stack: Snowflake warehouse + Klaviyo + Meta/Google. GTM Josh fit: warehouse-native retention, win-back, and lookalike audiences synced to Klaviyo + Meta without the lifecycle team rebuilding lists by hand; AI Decisioning on next-best-offer once audiences flow. Buyers: VP Growth/Marketing (economic), Director of Lifecycle/Retention (champion), Analytics Engineer (technical). Lead with conversion/LTV proof, not infrastructure.
ACC005.accountAiContext: Hyper-growth DTC apparel scaling retail + ecommerce; rich first-party data, retention/LTV and paid-social efficiency are priorities. Strong warehouse-native audience-activation fit; no active opportunity yet.

ACC006.name: Ramp
ACC006.accountResearch: Fast-growing fintech (corporate cards + spend management; New York, NY; founded 2019; multi-billion valuation) with an unusually strong engineering/data culture and a fast, data-driven GTM. Product + billing + usage data already modeled in a modern warehouse. Inferred stack: Snowflake + dbt, performance marketing into major ad platforms. GTM Josh fit: warehouse-to-ads activation with closed-loop (sync product-qualified audiences to ads/outbound, close the loop on conversions back to the warehouse), plus reverse ETL into CRM for sales. Buyers: Head of Growth Marketing/VP Marketing (economic), Growth/Marketing Ops (champion), Analytics Engineering (technical). Strong in-house build bias — win on time-to-value and governance; expect a technical eval.
ACC006.accountAiContext: Fintech with a sophisticated data org and performance-heavy GTM; product/billing data warehouse-resident. Strong fit for warehouse-to-ads closed-loop activation; discerning, build-biased buyer.

ACC007.name: Calendly
ACC007.accountResearch: Product-led scheduling SaaS (Atlanta, GA; founded 2013; ~$3B valuation) with a very large freemium user base and a self-serve + sales-assist motion. Enormous product-usage signal volume but generic nurture — activation milestones aren't reaching marketing in real time. Inferred stack: BigQuery warehouse with product events + a MAP (Marketo or similar). GTM Josh fit: PLG activation — sync product-usage milestones (first event created, teammate invited, usage thresholds) to the MAP and ads for timely nurture, PQL routing to sales, and expansion. Buyers: VP Marketing/Director of Demand Gen (economic), Demand Gen/Growth PM (champion), Analytics Engineering (technical). Light, fast PLG eval; lead with one high-value use case + same-week pilot.
ACC007.accountAiContext: PLG SaaS with huge product-usage signal but one-size nurture; demand-gen wants to trigger on aha-moment usage. Strong PLG-activation fit; multi-stakeholder, fast eval.

ACC008.name: Brooklinen
ACC008.accountResearch: Profitable, retention-driven DTC home-goods/bedding brand (Brooklyn, NY; founded 2014), an original DTC bedding player with a lean team and strong repeat-purchase motion plus growing retail/wholesale. Deep first-party purchase history; manual audience building in the ESP is a bottleneck; margin focus drives appetite for efficiency + suppression. Inferred stack: Snowflake + Klaviyo + ad platforms. GTM Josh fit: warehouse-native lifecycle + suppression audiences (replenishment, win-back, VIP, high-AOV) synced to Klaviyo + ads, plus suppression of recent purchasers to cut wasted spend, without the lean team hand-building lists. Buyers: Director of Ecommerce/Head of Marketing (economic), Head of Retention/Lifecycle (champion), Data/Analytics (technical). Small team — lead with managed, low-lift activation and fast ROI.
ACC008.accountAiContext: Profitable lean DTC bedding brand, retention-led with deep purchase history; manual ESP audience building is the bottleneck. Strong lifecycle + suppression activation fit; limited technical bandwidth.
